patch.value: Measure credential_key_assignment false positives against a captured corpus of real agent text instead of review-by-review shapes

pm-gh1704 added the mutation-only credential_key_assignment rule. Its PR 1712 reviews surfaced about a dozen false-positive shapes one round at a time, all fixed and pinned in the secret-policy-parity must-allow corpus: quoted and unquoted prose, masks, placeholders, paths, key-file names, member paths, optional chains, fallback expressions and constant references. The tail is open-ended, and in the default advise mode a false positive costs one warning, while in block mode it refuses a write. Capture a redacted corpus of real pm descriptions, comments and notes (for example from this tracker's history), declare a false-positive-rate measurement over it as an assurance provider, and bound it with an assertion, so new shapes are found by measurement rather than by reviewers.

A redacted corpus of real agent text is committed with capture provenance; An assurance measurement reports the credential_key_assignment false-positive rate over it, and an assertion bounds that rate; Each newly found false positive is added to the corpus with its fix
False positives are found by measurement over representative text
False positives were found one review round at a time
